stages.discovery: Distant screaming and clashing steel echo from beyond the ridge, underscored by something worse - a low, rattling moan that isn't human.

choices.label: Get a Vantage Point First
choices.description: Take a look before closing in
choices.outcome: From higher ground you spot torchlight and a makeshift barricade - guards making a stand against something crawling out of the dark.

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - just keep walking

stages.ignore: You walk away and let the night keep whatever's brewing behind the ridge.

stages.discovery: You crest the ridge to a barricade groaning under the weight of clawing, bony hands. Torches gutter as skeletal shapes claw over the wood.

choices.label: Charge the Barricade
choices.description: Rush in to help hold the line

choices.label: Assess the Line First
choices.description: Get a sense of what you're walking into
choices.outcome: You count a handful of guards holding, and more dead climbing out of the earth than there are living hands to stop them.

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - turn back now

stages.ignore: You turn from the ridge and leave the guards to hold or fall on their own.

stages.discovery: A handful of town guards are making a desperate last stand against a rising tide of undead.
stages.sneak_success: You skirt the battle and slip past while the undead are fully occupied with the guards.
stages.sneak_fail: A stray skeleton breaks off from the guards' line and shambles straight for you.
stages.ignore: You leave the guards to hold the line alone and hope they last the night.

choices.label: Investigate
choices.description: Walk in and see what's happening

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Stealth check to glimpse it unseen

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - just keep walking

victim_data.dialogue: We can't hold much longer - lend us a hand!
thanks: We held the line thanks to you. Well fought, adventurer.
after: Still catching my breath - but we're alive, thanks to you.

waves.discovery: Just as the barricade falls quiet, the earth beyond it churns - a second, larger wave of undead is dragging itself out of the ground.

aftermath.discovery: The last of the undead crumble to dust. The surviving guards are already dragging bodies clear of the barricade, watching the treeline for any more.

choices.label: Help Fortify the Barricade
choices.description: Stay and lend a hand in case more come
choices.outcome: You spend the next while hauling timber and driving stakes alongside the guards. By the time you're done, the barricade could hold against twice as many.

choices.label: Move On
choices.description: ESC also cancels - the guards can finish on their own
choices.outcome: You leave the guards to finish shoring up the barricade themselves and continue on your way.
